# Day 5 — Shared Resources, Country Results and the Way Forward

*Friday (morning only) · Turning a week of practice into a continental resource and into commitments under the Action Plan*

## Morning · 09:00 – 12:30

### 09:00–10:15 &nbsp;·&nbsp; Assisting countries in publishing their work

:material-presentation: **Talk** &nbsp;·&nbsp; Action Plan 2.1.1 · 4.2.1 · 3.2.1

How a national team takes what it built this week to a durable public product — repository structure and README conventions, GitHub Pages, dataset and code licensing, DOI and citation, metadata, versioning and maintenance responsibility. Concludes with the offer of continued support from the Secretariat and the route for submitting national work to the STG17 catalogue of best practices.
